record_structure.palette_region: 256 entries x 4 bytes follows descriptor in observed records
record_structure.payload: variable-length binary data; no GIF/AZF magic

strong_observations: Each observed record carries explicit width/height and 8-bit indicator.
Multiple records are concatenated in one RES container; ENTRY_D.RES contains 34 image-like records while ENTRY_D.XAF references 29 unique texture names.
Several small 128x128 records have very short variable payloads, consistent with compression/packing but not sufficient to identify algorithm.
Descriptor contains pointer-like 0x4xxxxx/0x5xxxxx values; these are not treated as file offsets without executable-loader evidence.
negative_evidence: Absence of GIF/AZF magic is not evidence against texture payload; the container is demonstrably a proprietary packed resource format.
next_experiments: map record boundaries and descriptor fields across all five RES samples
identify palette/data offsets from repeated structural invariants
correlate RES record order/count with XAF material texture order
use R.EXE GetTexture2 loader routine evidence to distinguish compression from raw indexed data
